# Mark Calderon

> Mark Calderon (Mark Angeo G. Calderon) is a Senior Frontend Developer with 7+ years building SPA to enterprise web applications and 80+ WordPress custom themes and landing pages, for clients in the Philippines, Japan, Australia, and the US. Open to full-time roles and freelance work.

## Numbers

- 7+ years building for the web
- 80+ WordPress custom themes and landing pages
- 70+ CMS and landing pages for Commude Japan clients
- 4 markets: Philippines, Japan, Australia, United States

## Experience

- Senior Developer, Saphyroo (Feb 2026 to present, remote, Victoria, Australia): legacy-to-modern stack migration, UI/UX strategy, API integrations, QA and performance delivery, AI-driven development rules.
- Senior Frontend Developer, We Are Dotty! (Oct 2021 to Jan 2026, remote, Makati, Philippines): enterprise apps across lease management, logistics, document review, digital marketing, and content delivery. Department MVP (Q2 2025), Dottyzens of the Month (June 2022).
- Team Lead and Front-End Web Developer, Commude Philippines (Oct 2019 to Oct 2021, Metro Manila): 70+ CMS and landing page projects with Commude Japan teams. Promoted within 6 months. MVP (Jan to Apr 2021).
- ICT Teacher, Seri Mulia Sarjana International School (Jun 2015 to Mar 2019, Brunei): Best Class Teacher of the Month (March 2019), advised Tech Kids (Third Place, 2019) and BICTA Young Developers Award (2016) teams.

- [Philippine Adventure Holidays](https://www.philippineadventureholidays.com/): tour reservation platform with package browsing, online booking, and custom itineraries.
- [Barambah Organics](https://customers.barambahorganics.com.au/): customer portal for an Australian organic dairy brand.
- [Pryce Gardens](https://prycegardens.com/): lot booking and memorial planning platform for a memorial park group in Mindanao.
- [University of Creativity](https://uoc.world/): content delivery platform for a Tokyo creative institution.
